title: CommitSmith Codex CLI Commit Response (v1)
description: Defines the shape of commit message payloads produced by the Codex CLI. Increment the .vN suffix in both file name and schema id whenever the structure changes.

meta.description: Optional metadata generated alongside the commit message.

style.description: Commit message style used to construct the response (e.g. conventional).

scope.description: Optional scope inferred from the journal or repository.

notes.description: Additional guidance or caveats supplied by Codex.
